comments.body:
Quest name: Mystery of the Hair Ornament
Quest location: Aden Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r11 Recognition, r13 Geography, ARA(Arabic)
Pre-requisite discovery: Waw An Namus discovery (from "Searching for His Sister" quest)

comments.author: RiceEater
comments.body:
[IMG:Obtained_Info]
[IMG:01] 1. Broken Hair Ornament
I heard that you found this hair ornament, broken, near an ancient volcano in the west. This hair ornament that looks exactly like the one I gave to my sister...
The hair ornament I gave was crafted by me. There's mo other like it. So, my sister was with the broken hair ornament and ...

[IMG:01] 2. Hair Ornament Delivered to Her Brother
...But, then what about the hair ornament that was delivered to me? It looks exactly like the one I made. My sister or someone else must have made it to look like it. Isn't it strange that I received a request to find a man wearing blue with that hair ornament attached to it?

[IMG:01] 3. Intention of the Requester
It's a little late, but I'm starting to think that there's something strange about this request. It's not just a request to look for someone. Maybe there's a hidden intention behind it...
To get to the bottom of this, I want to investigate the Guild that gave this request. It's the Adventure Guild in Tunis.
Can you go ask about it for me?

[IMG:01] 4. Requester was a 'Man in Blue'
A request with a hair ornament?
Yeah, I remember.
It was unexpected because a well-built man with a cute hair ornament came to send the request. The man's looks were...
That's right, he wore a dark blue robe. He had a silver cross on his chest, and had a dagger in the shape of a scorpion on his waist...

[IMG:01] 5. Letter from the 'Man in Blue'
...Actually, I have a letter from that man. He said that if someone came to ask about the hair ornament. I should show it to them.
I don't know what it says but...
Here you go.

[IMG:04] 6. Man's Confession
...The 'silver jasmine' died at the foot of the ancient volcano. The kind girl, who enjoyed talking about her beloved brother, passed away with the gift from her brother. It was all because of my mistake for not being able to escape from all the pursuers.
I must end my mistake and the cycle of revenge that swallow up the innocent...

[IMG:04] 7. Land of Determination
...I know where the bandit's base is. It's east from here, at the White Desert with oddly-shaped rocks. I will end their lives there. I have no plan to return, nor any intention to return.
So, I will leave a request to find me, together with the hair ornament designed after jasmine...

[IMG:04] 8. Wish Left Behind
...The one who will come after will most likely be the brother. Forgive me for having impersonated the girl, whom I was not able to protect, within the request I sent earlier.
If you would, could you hear out my selfish wish? I want you to see through the end of this mistake and the cycle of revenge. None other than her brother...

[IMG:06] 9. To the White Desert
The one who sent the request with the hair ornament to look for the 'man in blue' was the man himself.
It seems like he was with the Suez man's sister, but he wasn't able to protect her.
There are things that still remain mysterious like the identity of the pursuers and the meaning of the cycle of revenge, but first let's head to the desert that the man headed to.
You should be able to observe it if you land at the Egypt North Coast.

Quest Details:
You once took a request to look for a missing sister from a man in Suez, right?
That man says there's something bothering him. He seems to be struggling with the hair ornament you found...
If possible, please help him again.
